shorts_extract.hook: Five planted students in a sunlit Swarthmore room calmly name the wrong black line on an easel card, leaving Seat 6 trapped.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Asch's 18-trial line comparison across 123 critical subjects (<1% solo error vs 36.8% group conformity, 75% yielding at least once).
shorts_extract.twist: One single truthful dissenter shatters unanimity and cuts conformity from 36.8% down to 5.5%.
